analysis: All 27 Opus patches were reconciled against the CURRENT files. 24 anchors apply verbatim. Three anchors no longer exist because of the earlier compiler-string fix and the integrity patches and are re-anchored here rather than dropped: (a) the ESTABLISHED statement is now built with `var s` lines, so the two statement patches are rewritten on those lines while keeping the current, more conservative wording (trace evidence about the calibrated copies, not an observation of the originals' instruction sequence) and adding the host-unpack, guard and finiteness clauses plus the 'first differing running sum, not the compiled instruction' ending; (b) the variants loop currently uses a local `calibrated` helper, so that block is replaced wholesale by the new VariantDiff construction (pure final equality, last-sum equality and run integrity as separate flags; split never attributable by construction); (c) the current uninstrumented block sets report.error on a non-finite or guard-violated baseline (aborted), which is replaced by the finite/contract/guard gate that yields the new integrityFailed status (exit 3) and refuses to dispatch any instrumented copy. finalStatus is re-ordered so that a non-COMPLETED original is aborted, a non-intact original is integrityFailed, a missing or non-COMPLETED trace is aborted, a non-intact trace is integrityFailed, and only then notReproduced or completed. The report kind becomes q4-first-divergence-diagnostic-v2 with codegen q4fd-v2; the v1 run and its report are recorded in closedRecords as preserved and are not retagged. The one unverifiable item is the mirror check against Gemma4Runner.shaderSource: the production-shaped prologue in the emitter was written from the reviewed production body, not extracted text; if the pure mirror test reports a skeleton or term-line difference, the review's conditional patch applies (replace only the production-shape emitter lines with the extracted original lines verbatim, never relax the check). Pure test count after patches is 21. No phase-65 prefix code, kernel, corpus, flag, model or default is touched.

limitations: Not compiled or run by me; independent review and the single v2 GPU run decide. The v1 report and its status stand as recorded under kind v1 and are not retagged.

The mirror check compares the emitter's production-shape lines with the uniquely extracted g4_q4_matvec body from Gemma4Runner.shaderSource, which I have not seen verbatim. If the pure test prints a 'mirror:' skeleton or term-line difference, apply the review's conditional patch (production-shape emitter lines replaced by the extracted original lines, verbatim) and never relax the check or edit the production source.

Trimmed-line comparison tolerates indentation only; a different line break inside the production signature or prologue is a mirror failure by design and refuses the run as unsupported before any dispatch.

Final calibration of the sum-only trace is necessary, not sufficient: ESTABLISHED locates the first differing running sum of the calibrated copies and never proves the originals' unobservable intermediates or instruction sequence. The split trace never attributes.

The production original is compiled inside the full shaderSource library while its copies are standalone libraries; line mirroring does not guarantee identical code generation across library contexts, which is exactly what the calibration gate measures.
options nil is the SDK default math mode; the current note's characterization is retained unchanged and the four CPU models are hypotheses that do not enumerate every permitted rewrite.

Behaviour change versus v1: a non-finite, out-of-contract or guard-violated original now yields integrityFailed (exit 3) instead of aborted, and no instrumented copy is dispatched in that case; any non-COMPLETED completion is aborted. No kernel, corpus, flag, model, default or phase-65 code is changed.
